episodes.synopsis: As Lord Enma passes judgement on the denizens of hell, Hozuki's past is revealed. Has he always been a demon?
episodes.title: Ancient Underworld Overhaul / The Palace with the Malice

episodes.synopsis: Hozuki takes Maki and Miki around as hell minions to capture special tortures never seen before on film!
episodes.title: Hell Minion for a Day / The Line Between Workaholic and Artist

episodes.synopsis: The Four Benevolent Beasts argue over a meal about who is older and how well they are aging. Meanwhile, Hozuki has some problems of his own down in Hell.
episodes.title: The Auspicious Alliance / Eccentric Cuckoo-land Creature

episodes.synopsis: Koban the paparazzo gets an interview with Mustard. When Hozuki gets involved in the interview as well, Koban gets far more of a performance than he bargained for.
episodes.title: The Legend of Mustard / Please Turnip for the Demon Parade

episodes.synopsis: After continually being mistaken for the Great King Enma, King Shinko muses about how he should differ himself to avoid future confusion with the deceased.
episodes.title: Ono no Takamura / Great King Enma and Anecdotes

episodes.synopsis: We get a look at Young Hozuki and what he was like when he was younger. Later, Hozuki has to deal with some children who ended up in Hell.
episodes.title: Princess Sakuya's Showtime / The Battle of Children's Limbo

episodes.synopsis: The inventions and ideas of the Engineering Department are being discussed while Young Hozuki tries to make sense of it all.
episodes.title: In Those Days You Were Always On Edge / Dr. Monkshood

episodes.synopsis: Young Hozuki accidentally discovers the dead and meets quite a unique King with an extraordinary power.
episodes.title: Hopping Vampire

episodes.synopsis: A showdown arises between the Cold Hells and the Hot Hells. Meanwhile, Hozuki unravels the path of how the deceased enter hell.
episodes.title: Snow Demon / The Offices of Boring

episodes.synopsis: Hozuki is questioned about his humdrum, daily program in the normal world. Meanwhile, the Gods demonstrate their extraordinary matchmaking capabilities.
episodes.title: Kagachi's Coolheadedness / Married to His Work

episodes.synopsis: Hozuki, with great reluctance, agrees to take a vacation for the weekend. In the meantime, the dogs bicker as they try to distinguish themselves amongst each other.
episodes.title: Family / The Hounds of Hell

episodes.synopsis: Shiro discovers the mighty Scales of Karma and yearns to do one more thing that will make him an accomplished dog of hell.
episodes.title: King Gokan's Chief of Staff / Hell's Hot Springs

episodes.synopsis: The arrival of a special guest brings an unceasing barrage of annoyances as Hozuki prepares for the end of year party.
episodes.title: Master of Hell / Have a Drink and Get Some Rest
